messages:
josh: Heads-up — found a UI gating mismatch after yesterday's role-matrix refactor. Viewers can see the "Edit policy" button on some console pages. Repro steps attached.

maria: ugh. do we know if it's client-only or server enforcement missing?

josh: quickly checked: server-side API still enforces permissions for writes, but the UI shows buttons based on the new role map keys. So UX leak + confusing surface area, potential for phishing/scam if users expect action to work.

sanjay: that reduces blast but still an information leak. Also could be exploited by buggy clients. Can you paste the repro steps?

josh: steps:
1) login as user with role viewer (role id: viewer-basic)
2) go to Console > Projects > Project X > Settings
3) observe "Edit policy" button visible
4) click -> you get a 403 from POST /api/v1/policies/:id

josh: quick snippet showing what UI is doing:
```js
// client-side gating
if (hasPermission(user, 'policies:edit')) showEditBtn();
// but hasPermission() reads from roleMap.clientKeys which got renamed in the refactor
```

kevin: Looks like the refactor introduced two role key namespaces: clientKeys vs authzKeys. UI is still reading clientKeys which accidentally maps viewers -> can_view_flags. server uses authzKeys. so mismatch.

ellie: Is this tied to the RBAC role name migration we ran yesterday? I saw a job that swapped keys and wrote to account metadata.

maria: yes the migration wrote a new role_map json with shorter keys. Some frontends pulled a cached role_map from S3 and didn't refresh.

ops-bot: deploy: rollout/console-frontend v2.14.3 started by @deploy-bot :rocket:

sanjay: immediate mitigation: hide any edit controls for viewers via a quick override in CSS or render path? Prefer a server-side fix of course.

kevin: I can push a client hotfix to make UI rely on server /api/v1/permissions endpoint instead of local role_map. That will force correct coupling.

josh: +1. Also add a temporary feature-flag to hide risky actions for any role that isn't explicitly admin/editor.

ellie: TODOs: 
- kevin: client hotfix -> use permissions endpoint, roll back to hidden buttons if endpoint unavailable. 
- sanjay: add integration test asserting UI never shows edit for viewer users. 
- maria: check migration logs, revert if migration state inconsistent across regions. 
- josh: document incident and send notification to compliance.

maria: additionally — audit logging/KMS question: we should ensure the role_map migration writes are *encrypted* under customer KMS keys for Private deployments and that those key IDs are recorded in the audit events.

sanjay: good point. Right now the audit event includes actor, timestamp, change, but not KMS key id. For Private we need that for attestations.

kevin: ops: do we have an existing audit schema? I can add a field kms_key_id and a new event type role_map.migrate.

ops-bot: audit: new event queued role_map.migrate by josh at 1770504300

ellie: vuln triage note: label this P2 (info-leak, low immediate risk). But escalate if we find any client that retries requests with different creds.

qa-bot: QA repro attached: https://redwood-internal.test/repro/1770504321-screenshots.zip :eyeglasses:

josh: timeline proposal: hotfix client within 2 hours -> server-side permission guard unit tests merged in 24 hours -> add audit kms_key_id in next patch -> postmortem in 48 hours.

maria: ping @legal and @compliance for whether we need to notify customers. I think since writes were blocked it's internal, but we still exposed UI differences tied to project names.

sanjay: I'll run a quick scan for logs where viewer role triggered UI-surface calls to admin endpoints. If anything shows >3 attempts, escalate.

kevin: starting client branch now. Will fallback to hiding edit buttons by default and call /api/v1/permissions.

ellie: note for Dedicated/Private: ensure migration job uses the per-tenant KMS id when encrypting role_map, not the global fallback key.

josh: thanks team. keep replies short. if you find evidence of exploit push to this thread. :thumbsup:

maria: will follow-up with migration audit dump in this thread.

kevin: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/console-frontend/pull/5023 (hotfix + feature-flag)

sanjay: added integration test in infra/tests/rbac_ui_test.go

ops-bot: deploy: rollout/console-frontend v2.14.3 completed in us-west-2 :white_check_mark:

josh: closing loop: client hotfix deployed, server enforced check confirmed, added audit event role_map.migrate that includes kms_key_id for Private tenants, QA verified viewer no longer sees edit buttons. Postmortem draft incoming.

ellie: postmortem addendum: ensure we add a migration rollout plan so frontends refresh cached artifacts and region consistency checks.

maria: thanks everyone, will pull compliance notes and notify a subset of customers if needed.

kevin: :shipit:
